test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 12 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A stick was broken in two parts which have lengths in the ratio 7 ∶ 11. If the length of the smaller part was 77 cm, find the length of the unbroken stick.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of parts = 7 : 11

Smaller part (7 units) = 77 cm

1 unit = 77 ÷ 7 = 11 cm

Total length = (7 + 11) units = 18 units

Total length = 18 × 11 = 198 cm = 1.98 m

**∴ The correct answer is 1.98 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Ratio of parts = 7 : 11; Smaller part = 77 cm.

Formula Used: Total Length = Part 1 + Part 2

 
 
 
• 
 7 units

• 
 Total Unbroken Stick

⇒ Let the two parts be 7x and 11x.

⇒ According to the question, 7x = 77 cm

⇒ x = 77 ÷ 7 = 11 cm

⇒ Length of the larger part = 11x = 11 × 11 = 121 cm

⇒ Total length of the unbroken stick = 77 + 121 = 198 cm

⇒ Conversion to meters: 198 ÷ 100 = 1.98 m

**∴ The correct answer is 1.98 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio and Proportion

Ratio is the comparison of two quantities of the same unit. If a : b is given and the value of one part is k, the actual values are ak and bk.

Total from Ratios

If parts are in ratio a : b, the total is proportional to (a + b). Total = (Sum of ratio parts) × (Value of one unit).

Unit Conversion

1 meter (m) = 100 centimeters (cm). To convert cm to m, divide the value by 100.

Difference between Parts

The difference between the parts is proportional to |a − b|. Here, difference = (11 − 7) units = 4 units = 44 cm.</p
